headline: Building Distributed SQLite With Raft Log Replication
body: Launched on GitHub in September 2014, rqlite pairs SQLite with a Raft log to replicate writes. Distributing data across a cluster prevents loss if a node fails.
caption:
Building Distributed SQLite With Raft Log Replication

Launched on GitHub in September 2014, rqlite pairs SQLite with a Raft log to replicate writes. Distributing data across a cluster prevents loss if a node fails.
